Apology after two women's rights campaigners banned
Bristol City Council agrees to pay legal costs after two gender critical campaigners were banned.
Russell T Davies says he gets daily hate messages for supporting trans rights
The Doctor Who writer says his latest mini-series TipToe has fuelled daily hate messages online.
GP says she was forced out of job after raising concerns about gender treatment
The doctor says she faced a brutal investigation after she passed on complaints brought to her by other doctors.
Gender critical teacher 'could have shown respect'
A hearing is told Kevin Lister felt his college had an 'intimidating' culture on the subject.
Teacher 'protected' pupil by rejecting pronouns
Kevin Lister refused to address a transgender pupil by their preferred name and pronouns in class.
Trans army veteran's show to feature tales of survival and injustice
Claire Ashton attracted national attention when she transitioned to become a woman in the 1990s.
The Voice singer Ciiara Nyx says music helped her navigate her trans identity
The 21-year-old Worcestershire singer says she is now "very sure of who I am".
Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
New guidance says trans patients should be cared for on single-sex hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex.
More trans-inclusive spaces planned for city
An Oxford City Council meeting voted for more inclusive spaces, including gender-neutral facilities.
